Method of Attack: Spam campaign targeting Chinese recipients with phishing emails pretending to be from DHL
Attachment of a ZIP file containing a malicious executable named 'DHL海关申报单.doc.exe'
Execution of REvil ransomware that deletes Shadow Volume Copies using PowerShell WMI command
Encryption of victim's files with random extensions
Ransom note directing victims to Sodinokibi Tor payment site
Attack Vector: Phishing email with malicious attachment disguised as a Word document
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious executable inside ZIP: DHL海关申报单.doc.exe
